name: Self-Hosted LLM vs API: When Does Self-Hosting Pay Off
title: Self-Hosted LLM vs API: When Does Self-Hosting Pay Off
summary: If you pay an API bill for an open-weight model, you may wonder whether your own GPU would cost less. GPU rent is charged every hour, busy or idle, while an API charges only for the tokens you use.
